Description: E&S Review dedicated single-owner reference. No public application ingress; operator uses SSM port forwarding. Creates billable EC2 and encrypted retained EBS; not a shared multi-user service.

SubnetId.Description: Customer subnet with HTTPS egress to SSM and the selected image registry; no inbound application connection required.

AmiId.Description: Approved immutable x86_64 Linux AMI with podman, active SSM Agent, xfsprogs, curl and systemd already installed. Record its provenance; bootstrap never installs unpinned OS packages.

ApplicationImage.Description: Approved digest-pinned community image accessible without private credentials. Verify the signed image/OCI digest before supplying it.

ReleaseIdentifier.Description: Approved release or source commit bound to the assurance package.

Properties.GroupDescription: No inbound ports. HTTPS egress only for SSM and approved registry.

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: SSM and digest-pinned image fetch. Customer may replace with private endpoint routes.

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
command -v podman
command -v mkfs.xfs
getent passwd 1000 >/dev/null || useradd --uid 1000 --create-home esia
mkdir -p /var/lib/esia
volume_id='${DataVolume}'
serial_id=$(printf '%s' "$volume_id" | tr -d '-')
device=
for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
  for candidate in /dev/disk/by-id/nvme-Amazon_Elastic_Block_Store_*; do
    if [[ "$candidate" == *"$serial_id" ]]; then device=$(readlink -f "$candidate"); break; fi
  done
  [[ -n "$device" ]] && break
  sleep 5
done
[[ -b "$device" ]] || { echo 'Retained data volume was not attached within five minutes.' >&2; exit 1; }
if ! blkid "$device" >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkfs.xfs "$device"; fi
uuid=$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$device")
printf 'UUID=%s /var/lib/esia xfs defaults,nofail 0 2\n' "$uuid" >> /etc/fstab
mount /var/lib/esia
chown 1000:1000 /var/lib/esia
chmod 0700 /var/lib/esia
podman pull '${ApplicationImage}'
cat >/etc/systemd/system/esia-review.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=E&S Review dedicated loopback workspace
After=network-online.target
RequiresMountsFor=/var/lib/esia
[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --rm --name esia-review --network host --user 1000:1000 --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 128 --memory 1g --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=256m,mode=1777 --volume /var/lib/esia:/data:Z '${ApplicationImage}'
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman stop --time 15 esia-review
TimeoutStopSec=30
Restart=no
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now esia-review.service
podman image inspect '${ApplicationImage}' >/var/lib/esia/deployment-image.json
printf '%s\n' '${ReleaseIdentifier}' >/var/lib/esia/deployment-release.txt

Access.Value: Use customer-authorized AWS-StartPortForwardingSession port 4173, then http://127.0.0.1:4173. Local accounts are one operator's custody partitions.
